text: Glass Skins 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的界面皮肤插件。它在设置中加入“皮肤”页面，可在九种配色间切换，并选择液体折射或磨砂模糊材质。用户还能调整透明度、高光、折射厚度、背景流动与光感，并控制光球漂移和指针反馈；关闭总开关即可停用皮肤。偏好写入插件配置并缓存于浏览器本地，无需 API 密钥或外部账号。

Glass Skins adds nine palettes and liquid or frosted glass to the DSH web interface. Users can switch themes and tune transparency, refraction and lighting in Settings → Skins. Preferences stay in plugin configuration and a browser-local cache; no key or account is needed.
想给 DSH 网页界面换一套玻璃风格的外观。
能不能在设置里切换不同配色，并调节透明度和折射效果？
I want to customize the look of the DSH web interface with glass themes.
Glass Skins 的功能「切换皮肤与配色」：在设置的皮肤页面中选择九种主题之一，也可用总开关启用或停用整套界面样式。
Glass Skins 的功能「调整玻璃材质」：在皮肤设置中选择液体折射或磨砂模糊，并调节透明度、高光厚度、折射厚度及背景光感。

dsh-plugin-skins README · 安装：将下面一行发到 DeepSeek Harness 对话：

```text
请安装并启用玻璃皮肤插件：https://github.com/I-QX-I/dsh-plugin-skins/releases/download/v2.6.3/glass-skins.zip；按包内 AI-INSTALL.md 执行，沿用当前 profile，保留已有偏好。
```

也可以[下载 glass-skins.zip](https://github.com/I-QX-I/dsh-plugin-skins/releases/download/v2.6.3/glass-skins.zip)，拖进对话后说「安装这个插件」。请使用 Release 安装包，不是 Source code ZIP。安装使用宿主插件管理器或官方 CLI，遵守宿主权限。

入口：**设置 → 皮肤**。新安装使用 Aero 液体玻璃预设，升级保留已有选择。原下载可移动或删除，宿主管理的安装缓存应保留。

dsh-plugin-skins README · Themes and materials：- Liquid and frosted glass; separate highlight and refraction-thickness controls.
- Adjustable gradient flow, light drift, color separation, opacity and lighting.
- Lightweight reading material for long drafts and messages, preserving message behavior.
- English/Chinese, host light/dark appearance, reduced motion and capability fallbacks.

dsh-plugin-skins README · Compatibility：Real-device checks primarily cover Windows Electron/Chromium Harness. macOS/Linux have not received real-device visual acceptance. Host updates may require adaptation. Fine corner strokes have pixel limits at some DPRs; pure transparency is experimental. See [Compatibility](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) and the [Device checklist](TEST-OTHER-DEVICE.md).

The plugin does not modify host executables, accounts, models, chat data or unrelated plugins.
